provenance: R 4.6.1, package COINT 0.0.4 (Ho Tsung-wu), function GHansen(y, x, model=1, trim=0.10, use=c('nw','ba')), executed via validation/external/spec29_ghansen.R on validation/external/spec29_synthetic.csv (n=200, seed=29, known level break at 0-indexed t=99). Raw R output: validation/results/external_logs/spec29_ghansen.log. Numeric capture: validation/external/spec29_ghansen.json.
notes: Spec 29 §5.4 named R funtimes::gh_coint as the external reference; that function does not exist in the current CRAN funtimes package (checked 2026-09-20, ls('package:funtimes') has no gh_coint) — documented as a deviation in docs/QUESTIONS.md. COINT::GHansen (Gregory & Hansen 1996A/1996B cited directly in its docs) is used instead. Lag selection differs between pyardl (MAIC-style select_lags) and R's urca::ur.df(selectlags='AIC') inside GHansen, so the ADF* statistics are not expected to match to a tight tolerance — only the break location and the decision (reject H0 at 1%) are asserted as a strict concordance; the statistic is checked only for same sign and same order of magnitude.
